savage-friend.roast: Bhai 7 streaming subscriptions pe ₹1,913 de raha hai aur har weekend bolta hai 'kuch dekhne ko nahi hai'. Netflix, Hotstar, SonyLIV, Prime Video sab tere paise pe chal rahe hain aur tu kisi ka ek season bhi poora nahi karta.
savage-friend.fix: Fix: Sirf Netflix aur Spotify rakh, baaki 5 aaj hi cancel kar, har mahine ₹1,145 bachenge.

savage-friend.roast: Chaayos pe 14 visits, ₹2,280 ki chai pi gaya yaar. Itni loyalty tu kisi insaan ko deta toh aaj single nahi hota.
savage-friend.fix: Fix: Chaayos hafte mein sirf ek baar, mahine ka cap ₹800.

savage-friend.roast: ₹1,120 ek hi raat ki movie pe, bhai recliner pe baitha tha ya producer ban gaya tha? Mahine mein BookMyShow ko ₹1,930 de diye, aur ghar pe 7 streaming subscriptions ro rahe hain.
savage-friend.fix: Fix: Movie sirf offer wale din, mahine ka cap ₹800.

desi-mummy.roast: Beta, 7 streaming subscriptions aur ₹1,913 har mahine? Sharma ji ka beta toh apne uncle ka login chalata hai aur ek paisa nahi deta.
desi-mummy.fix: Fix: Ek hi plan rakho, ₹649 wala Netflix, baaki sab band.

desi-mummy.roast: Zomato pe 12 order, ₹4,100, aur mummy ke haath ka khana 'boring' lagta hai? Sharma ji ka beta roz tiffin le jaata hai aur uska promotion bhi ho gaya.
desi-mummy.fix: Fix: Hafte mein 3 din ghar ka tiffin, Zomato cap ₹2,000.

desi-mummy.roast: BookMyShow pe ₹1,930 uda diye, ek hi baar mein ₹1,120. Itne mein toh poore ghar ke naye parde aa jaate, aur woh saal bhar chalte.
desi-mummy.fix: Fix: Movie sirf offer wale din, mahine ka cap ₹800.

ca-uncle.roast: Arre beta, ₹42,000 mein se sirf 24% kharcha, achha hai, lekin baaki paisa savings account mein so kyun raha hai? ELSS ka naam suna hai ya woh bhi koi naya OTT app hai?
ca-uncle.fix: Fix: Salary wale din ₹8,000 ki ELSS SIP auto-debit pe laga do.

ca-uncle.roast: Subscriptions and fun pe ₹3,843, 9 transactions, aur ek bhi rupaya tax mein claim nahi hoga. Main shaadi mein free ka khana khata hoon aur tum Zee5 ke ₹99 bhi bhar rahe ho.
ca-uncle.fix: Fix: Jo OTT pichhle hafte nahi khola woh cancel, target ₹1,000 mahine ki bachat.

ca-uncle.roast: Chaayos pe ₹2,280, 14 cup, beta chai pe bhi GST lagta hai pata hai? Humare time pe canteen ki chai thi aur usi bachat se plot liya tha.
ca-uncle.fix: Fix: Office pantry ki chai piyo, Chaayos cap ₹1,000 mahine ka.

cricket.roast: Aur yeh gaya! Zomato ne 12 overs mein ₹4,100 thok diye aur kitchen poore season bench pe baitha hai!
cricket.fix: Fix: Zomato ko ₹2,500 ka powerplay do, uske baad ghar ka khana.

cricket.roast: OTT ka batting order dekhiye, Netflix ₹649, Hotstar ₹299, SonyLIV ₹299, Prime Video ₹299, aur tail mein Zee5 ₹99 bhi aa gaya! 7 streaming subscriptions, ₹1,913, yeh partnership nahi, collapse hai!
cricket.fix: Fix: Hotstar, SonyLIV, Prime Video aur Zee5 ko drop karo, har mahine ₹996 bachao.

cricket.roast: Aur yeh BookMyShow pe ₹1,120 ka ek hi shot, seedha multiplex ki chhat ke paar! Mahine ka score ₹1,930, aur popcorn ka run rate alag se chal raha hai!
cricket.fix: Fix: Movies ka mahine ka target ₹800, uske baad ghar pe OTT.

villain.roast: Mogambo khush hua, tumne 7 streaming subscriptions le liye, ₹1,913 har mahine. Ab tumhari shaamein tumhari nahi, Netflix ki ghulam hain.
villain.fix: Fix: Ek waqt pe sirf ek OTT, har mahine rotate karo, ₹1,500 bachao.

villain.roast: Kitne cup the? 14 cup, ₹2,280, Chaayos ne tumhe chai pe bulaya aur tumhe hi loot liya.
villain.fix: Fix: Thermos mein ghar ki chai le jao, Chaayos ka cap ₹600.

villain.roast: BookMyShow pe ek hi raat mein ₹1,120, poore mahine mein ₹1,930. Picture abhi baaki hai mere dost, lekin tumhara balance The End ho chuka hai.
villain.fix: Fix: Movies ke liye ₹700 ka alag envelope, khatam toh ghar pe OTT.

shark-tank.roast: Toh aapka business model hai 7 streaming subscriptions, ₹1,913 ka monthly burn, aur customer ke paas dekhne ka time hi nahi. Main is deal se bahar hoon.
shark-tank.fix: Fix: Churn karo, sirf Netflix aur YouTube Premium rakho, ₹1,100 har mahine bachao.

shark-tank.roast: Zomato pe ₹4,100 ka acquisition cost aur return mein sirf 12 meals? Aapki unit economics itni kharab hai ki mujhe bhi bhook lag gayi.
shark-tank.fix: Fix: Sunday ko meal prep, Zomato budget ₹2,000 pe hard cap.

shark-tank.roast: Ek raat ki movie pe ₹1,120 ka burn, jab ghar pe 7 streaming subscriptions already chalu hain? Same product ke liye do baar pay karna business model nahi hai, I'm out.
shark-tank.fix: Fix: Ya theatre ya OTT, movies ka combined budget ₹1,500.

appraisal.roast: Is quarter aapne Subscriptions and fun mein ₹3,843 ka strong ownership dikhaya, 9 alag stakeholders ke saath. Bas ek feedback hai, aapki delivery kisi project pe nahi dikhi, sirf Hotstar pe.
appraisal.fix: Fix: Next cycle ka KPI: subscriptions ₹1,000 ke andar.

appraisal.roast: Chaayos mein aapki attendance 14 din, ₹2,280, jo office attendance se zyada consistent hai. Rating: exceeds expectations, Chaayos ki taraf se.
appraisal.fix: Fix: Chai breaks pantry mein shift karo, Chaayos cap ₹800.

appraisal.roast: BookMyShow pe ek hi evening mein ₹1,120, aapka weekend engagement exceptional hai. Bas ₹1,930 ka total dekh ke finance team ne aapko 'culture fit' se 'cost centre' mein shift kar diya hai.
appraisal.fix: Fix: Next cycle ka KPI: movies ₹800 ke andar, weekday shows only.

jyotishi.roast: Tumhari kundli mein grah nahi, 7 streaming subscriptions baithe hain, har mahine ₹1,913 ka dosh. Shani ki seedhi drishti Netflix ke ₹649 pe hai, bachcha.
jyotishi.fix: Fix: Amavasya se pehle 4 OTT cancel karo, ₹996 ka upay ho jayega.

jyotishi.roast: Main dekh raha hoon, Zomato ke 12 orders, ₹4,100, tumhari rasoi mein Rahu kaal chal raha hai. Jab tak chulha thanda rahega, bank balance garam nahi hoga.
jyotishi.fix: Fix: Hafte mein 4 din ghar pe pakao, Zomato ka cap ₹2,000.

jyotishi.roast: Tumhare haath ki rekha mein 19 chhoti payments dikh rahi hain, jaise naav mein chhote chhote chhed. Aur BookMyShow pe ek din mein ₹1,120, yeh Shukra ka nahi, shauk ka prabhav hai.
jyotishi.fix: Fix: Har Sunday ₹1,500 alag savings account mein, grah shaant rahenge.

hype.roast: Bhai ₹42,000 mein se sirf 24% kharch kiya, yeh legend behaviour hai, proud of you! Bas 7 streaming subscriptions dekh ke lagta hai tu content creator nahi, content collector hai.
hype.fix: Fix: Salary wale din ₹12,000 SIP mein daal, legend status permanent.

hype.roast: Poore mahine mein total ₹10,223 aur 35 transactions, bhai tu sach mein control mein hai! Bas Chaayos ke 14 visits se lagta hai tera asli office wahi hai.
hype.fix: Fix: Chaayos ₹1,200 tak rakh, baaki ₹1,080 seedha savings mein.

hype.roast: Zomato sirf 12 orders, ₹4,100, bhai yeh self-control ka masterclass hai! Bas BookMyShow pe ₹1,120 ek shot mein, recliner nahi, singhasan book kiya tha kya?
hype.fix: Fix: Movies ka ₹1,000 monthly cap, IMAX sirf special occasion pe.
